english.note: Use this when individualism means personal independence, especially acting or deciding without relying on others.

examples.english: They have always shown individualism, making their own decisions without needing anyone to arrange things.
examples.traditional: 佢由細到大都好自主，唔使人安排都識得自己作決定。
